items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: as I explained to him when I first met him

ctx.x: hanging out with cats and he had Louis and what have you. That was a different thing. He did not get into this thing. He did not, you see, Mr. Willard Alexander was the big man. But as I explained to him when I first met him, "Mr. Willard Alexander, you don't know anything about handling a black band. You know about handling a white band." He will tell you to this day that I told him. I told him on several occasions, "You still don't know how to handle a black band."
Later on, in some of these tapes from before, you said he came to you and asked your advice about it.
